name: Koatl The Defender ULTIMATE
description:
About This Game

Koatl The Defender ULTIMATE is a cinematic action-adventure that blends dynamic 2.5D platforming with fully realized 3D combat, creating a seamless and ever-evolving gameplay experience.

Set beneath the historic city of San Luis Potosí, a forgotten labyrinth of tunnels hides secrets buried for centuries. As a new threat begins to awaken in the depths, Koatl must descend into the unknown to confront a force that threatens both past and present.

Explore seven expansive tunnels, each crafted with distinct challenges, hidden paths, and ancient mysteries waiting to be uncovered. Along the way, players will collect powerful weapons inspired by the original comic lore, each one unlocking new abilities that reshape both combat and exploration.

Face off against formidable enemies and epic boss battles that push your skills to the limit, or take on the Boss Rush Mode, where up to five unique heroes stand against relentless encounters.

The journey is brought to life through a completely original story, carefully woven into the Koatl universe, and enhanced by immersive voice performances from renowned actors such as Carlos Segundo and Rubén Castro. Accompanied by a rich, atmospheric soundtrack, every moment is designed to pull you deeper into the legend.

Uncover lost relics, forgotten texts, and hidden collectibles that reveal the truth behind the tunnels and the destiny that awaits Koatl.

Key Features

Dual Gameplay Perspective

Seamlessly shift between 2.5D platforming and fully immersive 3D combat encounters.

A Vast Underground World

Explore unique tunnels filled with secrets, hidden paths, and environmental challenges.

Lore-Driven Weapons & Abilities

Discover and master weapons inspired by the Koatl comic universe, each unlocking new ways to fight and explore.

Epic Boss Battles

Take on powerful enemies that demand strategy, skill, and mastery of your abilities.

Boss Rush Mode

Challenge consecutive boss fights with up to 5 different heroes, each with distinct playstyles.

Original Story Campaign

Experience a narrative crafted specifically for this title, expanding the Koatl universe with depth and care.

Immersive Presentation

It features voice acting from renowned talents like Carlos Segundo and Rubén Castro, alongside a rich, atmospheric original soundtrack.

Secrets & Collectibles

Uncover lost relics, hidden lore, and rare items scattered throughout the tunnels.
short_desc: Descend into the hidden tunnels beneath San Luis Potosi, Mexico, in Koatl The Defender ULTIMATE, a cinematic action-adventure that blends 2.5D platforming with dynamic 3D combat. Uncover ancient secrets, wield powerful weapons, and face epic bosses in a world inspired by the Koatl comics.
developers: Seashell Studio, Yair Artz, Oribe Ware Games
publishers: Seashell Studio, Yair Artz, Oribe Ware Games
